subject: Launchpad kickoff — calendar sync, hands-on runbook, and prep packet
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@nimblehealth.com>, Carlos Gómez <carlos.gomez@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launchpad kickoff — calendar sync, hands-on runbook, and prep packet

Hi Priya / Carlos —

Looking forward to kicking off the POC. We want to run a focused hands-on working session where we'll:
- Walk through environment access and SSO whitelisting
- Review prompt sets and expected outputs (prompt review)
- Validate routing and fallback behavior on a few representative flows
- Run a short load smoke test (targeted concurrency)
- Capture action items and next-phase milestones

Can you confirm which of these two slots works on your side? Both are in PT:
- Thu, Mar 17 — 10:00–12:00 PT (2 hours, includes setup & smoke test)
- Fri, Mar 18 — 13:00–15:00 PT (2 hours)

Pre-reads I plan to send once the slot is locked:
- kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf (high-level timeline + owners) [attached]
- prompt_samples.csv (sample prompts we'll iterate on)
- load_test_playbook.md (what we'll run during the smoke test)

Quick asks before the session:
- Share a sample dataset or a few representative prompts (if you can)
- Confirm SSO domain/ip whitelist or add our test user: avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com

Marissa will lead the hands-on lab and Soojin will cover routing/load specifics.

If those slots don't work, send a couple of alternatives and we'll re-align.

Thanks —
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: launchpad_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

We can share a small sample set (anonymized) by EOD Tue. We'll also try to get SSO whitelisting done but I may need your public IP ranges — can you include them in the prep packet?

Subject: Launchpad: Fri 3/18 13:00–15:00 PT — invite + prep packet

Thanks — invite sent for Fri, Mar 18, 13:00–15:00 PT (Google Calendar).

I've created a shared Drive folder with the materials we'll use during the hands-on session: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3CkKickoffPacket

Pre-reads in the folder:
- launchpad_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf (timeline, owners, success criteria) [attached]
- prompt_samples.csv (examples to try during the lab)
- load_test_playbook.md (steps we'll run during the smoke test)
- environment_checklist.md (SSO/IP whitelist checklist + local validations)

A few logistics notes for you:
- Please upload the anonymized sample prompts to the Drive folder by Tue EOD so we can bake them into the runbook.
- For the smoke test we'll aim for ~10 concurrent sessions with mixed token lengths (short Q&A and 512-token summaries).
- We'll do a 10-minute preflight at 12:45 PT to confirm connectivity — please keep a point person on the call to approve the preflight.

Attachments: launchpad_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf, prompt_samples.csv

If NimbleHealth wants us to run the first few routing variants (priority routing -> fallback -> caching behavior) we can queue those in the first 45 minutes.

Looking forward to it —
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, POCs & Onboarding
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: prompt_samples.csv (text/csv)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 15:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launchpad: Fri 3/18 13:00–15:00 PT — invite + prep packet

One more technical note for the runbook:
- Routing test plan: we'll exercise 3 routing policies (latency-first, cost-first, and safe-fallback). I will prepare a short script to simulate 50 small requests and 20 long requests for each policy.
- KV-cache prewarm: bring a 2-minute warmup window before the main smoke test to populate common prefixes.
- Load test playbook (attached) contains exact payload sizes and the sequence lengths we'll use — please review ahead of time.

Attachments: load_test_playbook.md

If NimbleHealth has a preferred traffic profile (e.g., 70% short Q&A, 30% long summarization) toss it into the Drive and we'll match it.

— Soojin
Senior ML Engineer, Inference Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: load_test_playbook.md (text/markdown)]
